title: Python: resolveStarAttribute's may-skip refusal walk over-refuses and two tests need tightening (GCLI-127 round 2 notes)
description: From the GCLI-127 Opus round 2 non-blocking notes (opum-ai/glyph-cli#204, landed 9d900247). Lost edges, soundness holds. (1) The backward walk over earlier stars in resolveStarAttribute does not stop at an earlier UNCONDITIONAL star: a.py and b.py each def f; m.py is 'from a import *' / 'from b import *' / 'if C:' with 'from b import *'; 'import m; m.f()' gives no edge but Python binds b.f (the unconditional b star overrides a). Mirror GCLI-125's after-the-last-unconditional-binding rule in starOverride: stars before the last unconditional star are overridden. (2) A lost edge when both stars give the same module or both are external (the same-symbol check compares symbols only). (3) Tests: add a twin where an earlier star returns multiply that includes the deciding star's symbol (y gives {a.f,b.f}; expect no edge, which kills a mutant counting that as the same symbol); fix the title of the try-only-finally twin in test/python-hops.test.ts (the later always-run star gives b.py:f); pin WHICH bin the star-bound refusal lands in at the bin assertion (it currently asserts receiver + nameNotBound is 1). Same family as GCLI-129 (starOverride's same-symbol refusal). Not on the hold list.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the (1) input gives b.f in the attribute form, red before and green after with callees pinned and the full bin delta, and a star before an unconditional star still refuses nothing it should keep
(2) a same-module or both-external pair of stars is decided without refusing where one binding is possible
(3) the multiply-twin, the retitled twin and the pinned bin land with a mutant observed red
the five-pin corpus diff against dev is script-asserted with every moved site named; any in-repo edge created or removed comes to opum-doc before the clear
